google_scholar.method: manual Google Scholar export as 14 screenshots (no HTML, no Publish or Perish)
google_scholar.query: ("CirCor" OR "PhysioNet 2022" OR "PhysioNet Challenge 2022" OR "George B. Moody PhysioNet Challenge 2022") AND murmur
google_scholar.transcription: ranks 1-100 transcribed from the screenshots by Claude (cloud workspace) into scholar_manual.csv; checked against the PNGs, 0 errors (scholar_transcription_check.md)
google_scholar.screened: ranks 1-100 (locked protocol: first 100); ranks 101-140 kept in scholar_manual_extra_rank101-140.csv, NOT screened
google_scholar.resolution: DOI/URL resolved by title match via OpenAlex, Crossref fallback (scripts/p4_g3b_screen_prep.py)
google_scholar.note: OpenAlex free daily budget was exhausted on 2026-10-29 (HTTP 429, retry-after ~23 h) after the main searches; records it could not answer were resolved via Crossref only

semantic_scholar_retry.rule: >= 5 s between calls, max 3 tries per call
